name: Strix Halo 8060S llama.cpp HIP b8156: gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 prompt processing at depth 512
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Strix Halo HomeLab wiki llama.cpp performance page, reproducing the lhl/strix-halo-testing sweep). Framework Desktop, 128GB unified memory, ROCm/HIP backend, llama.cpp build b8156, -ngl 999, mmap disabled. gpt-oss-120b MXFP4. Depth 512 is the prompt length the point was measured at (pp and tg swept together, not the default pp512/tg128 pair). Per-request batch-1, NOT aggregate. Wiki rounds the raw logs.
